text: Saronite Ore is a metal ore found only in Northrend. The Scourge uses saronite to provide death knights with armor. Saronite is a new metal ore for mining in Northrend.

The Saronite Mines are located in the middle of Ymirheim, where the Vrykul keep slaves from the Argent Crusade to mine Saronite for the Scourge. The miners slowly lose their sanity due to the saronite being the blood of Yogg-Saron. Val'kyr oversee the mining operations and cruelly motivate the enslaved miners. The Ymirjar Foreman Thaldrin leads the operation. Darkspeaker R'khem, a faceless one, can also be found imprisoned here.

As such, she plays an important role in the story throughout the zone in supporting her boss/former boss ((the player character)) as he/she works to rescue the Goblins from the Isles. They are found across Pandaria, in dungeons and in the open. They also attacked The Wandering Isle from the sea, led by Vordraka, the Deep Sea Nightmare.

An addon may need to save settings and data between game sessions - that is, some information may need to persist through a user log out. To enable this, the addons may specify a number of variables to be saved to disk when the player's character logs out of the game, and restored when the character logs back in. Variables that are saved and restored by the client are called SavedVariables. Summary: to save a global variable FOOBAR, add ##SavedVariables: FOOBAR or ##SavedVariablesPerCharacter: FOOBAR to an addon's .toc file.

A scale is a type of item usually gathered with the Skinning profession from a skinnable scaled corpse. These items can usually be used directly by the Leatherworking profession without prior processing or treatment, but usually only with recipes acquired from non-Trainer NPCs or as drops.

== What are they? == This is the name given to data which is saved by the user interface and addons between play sessions, storing things such as configurations, collected data, etc. Saved variables are stored in several different files: All under X:/World of Warcraft Install Dir/_game_type_/WTF/Account/ACCOUNTNAME/: * ./SavedVariables.lua - only contains settings for Blizzard's own UI * ./SavedVariables/ADDONNAME.lua - global data, per AddOn * ./REALMNAME/CHARNAME/SavedVariables/ADDONNAME.lua - per-character data, per AddOn The format of these files is plain Lua. In theory, you could put actual code in them and have it be loaded, but it would be overwritten the next time variables are saved

The sayaad (pronounced say-ahd) (adjective form sayaadi) are a species of seductive and sadistic demons who look similar to the nathrezim. Many serve the Burning Legion, but others serve only themselves or can be impressed by a warlock master. Only female sayaad are commonly seen, and are known as succubi (singular succubus). The males are named incubi (singular incubus). Sayaad can change their appearance between succubus and incubus form to match their master's preferences.

Invented for questionable purposes and usually sold behind closed doors to questionable people, the sawtooth ring is nonetheless a remarkable device. Though it appears to be a normal ring, the two halves of a sawtooth ring can be pulled apart to reveal a band of sharpened teeth wound tightly inside. Captured rogues often use a sawtooth ring to cut their way free of bonds, but the rings also have the potential for use as a melee weapon.

The Savage Glen is a wooded area found west and north of the Wild Overlook on the Lost Isles. The area is crawling with SI:7 Assassins and Jungle Cats. The Teraptor Matriarch can be found on the cliff overlooking the Shipwreck Shore.
The Savage Raptor is obtained from the War of the Elements TCG expansion set.
Savior of Azeroth is a title awarded when you complete Heroic: Madness of Deathwing by defeating Deathwing on heroic difficulty. The title appears after your character's name: :"", Savior of Azeroth
Sayari is a draenei shaman student wandering in the Crystal Hall of the Exodar, along with fellow student Drysc and their teacher Chakaa.
Scalder is a water elemental located at Winterfin Village in the Borean Tundra.
Save it for Later is a scenario achievement. To earn this achievement, players must not use the Volatile Greenstone Brew during Stage 4 and the Final Stage of the Greenstone Village (scenario).
Savior of Stoneplow is a quest achievement earned for defeating the Ik'thik Colossus.
__NOTOC__ Scalebane Bracers drop from Galakras in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Sawame Brightburn is a blood elf vendor located in the Frostwall garrison.
Savage World is a series of literature tied to World of Warcraft: Warlords of Draenor featured on the official page. It's the counterpart of the Destination: Pandaria category.
Saving Anchorite's Sojourn is an event found at in Anchorite's Sojourn in east-central Talador. As of build 18761, it does not appear to be fully-implemented for Horde-side characters.
Savage Hero is a dungeon & raids achievement earned from defeating all Draenor dungeon and raid bosses on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Savagely Superior is a Legacy achievement earned for equipping items in every slot with a minimum item level of 608 prior to Patch 8.0.1.
Savagely Epic is a Legacy achievement earned for equipping items in every slot with a minimum item level of 640 prior to Patch 8.0.1.
Saving Grace is a Discipline and Holy priest talent, available at level 100.

Savage Piranha are caught in the inland waters of Ashran for those with fishing skill under ~700. Players will rarely catch them with fishing skill above 800. Eating this will grant the appearance of a mag'har orc ninja or pirate.

A Scale Model of Gorgorek can be found at Mok'gol Watchpost in Nagrand. It depicts the petrified magnaron Gorgorek in Gorgrond, and notes describing him can be found nearby: : This miniature is discovered during the Garrison Campaign, and is one of the first clues of the Iron Horde's plans to use Gorgorek as a war beast.
Savory Savage Delights were created by gutting and cleaning Small Savage Piranha, Savage Piranha, and Enormous Savage Piranha. Eating this would grant the same effect as the Savage Piranha.
Savage Satchel of Cooperation is awarded for completing a class role that's in demand through Dungeon Finder or Raid Finder.
Savage Skills to Pay the Bills was a professions achievement rewarded upon obtaining 700 skill points in fishing, first aid, cooking, and archaeology.

The Scale of the Earth-Warder, also known as the Blackwyrm Armaments, is one of the artifacts used by protection warriors in World of Warcraft: Legion. Equipping it will automatically place Scaleshard in your main hand.
Savage Hexweave Essence is created with Tailoring (1); taught by Pattern: Savage Hexweave Essence.
Savage Weapon Crystal is created with Inscription (1); taught by Technique: Savage Weapon Crystal.
Savage Steelforged Essence is created with Blacksmithing (1); taught by Plans: Savage Steelforged Essence.
Savage Truesteel Essence is created with Blacksmithing (1); taught by Plans: Savage Truesteel Essence.
__NOTOC__ Saylanna Riverbreeze is a night elf quest giver located at Lunarwing Shallows in Val'sharah.
Savage Taladite Amplifier is crafted with Jewelcrafting (1); taught by Recipe: Savage Taladite Amplifier.
Savage Great Whites are great white sharks located in the Great Sea off the shores of the Broken Isles. They are usually acompanied by a few Isle Remora Sharks.
Savage Momentum is a Feral druid PvP talent, available at level 27.
Savyn Valorborn is a Val'kyr located in Skyhold. Savin can recruit Shieldmaiden Warbands or Valkyra Shieldmaidens if the class hall advancement Ascension is chosen.

The Scaleback Run in Neltharion's Lair is an underground river full of basilisks. It is not visited in a normal run, but leads back to the Mushroom Merchant overlooking the first room and selling the Ketchum Tablet used in Got to Ketchum All.
Savage Tarot is crafted with Inscription (1); taught by Draenor Inscription (item). Required tools: *Virtuoso Inking Set
__NOTOC__ Savage Whale Sharks are whale sharks located in Tanaan Jungle.
The Savage Leather Tent is a placable tent that provides a stat bonus if rested in.
Savage Wendigo are wendigo located in the Waning Glacier in Tiragarde Sound.
